useWorksheetAssessment hook
nodes.rationale: Holds assessment state outside WorksheetsTab.jsx, which already carries the upload and CRUD flow at 370 lines.

nodes.label: AssessmentsTab.jsx
nodes.rationale: Retired because it queried four tables that exist in no SQL file, and worksheets now carry questions.

nodes.label: guard_worksheet_submission_write()
nodes.rationale: A trigger guards scoring columns because RLS grants or denies whole rows and cannot restrict individual columns.

nodes.label: ws_subs_student_write policy
nodes.rationale: Pins scoring columns NULL because the guard trigger only fires BEFORE UPDATE, so a student could otherwise INSERT a pre-filled score.

nodes.label: Answer key isolation
nodes.rationale: Any row a student can read is readable entirely, so the key sits in its own table where RLS can deny it while still serving the question.

nodes.label: Teacher-side auto-checking
nodes.rationale: Checking needs the key, and a key reaching a student client can be read off the API whatever the UI renders.

nodes.label: Manual checking by default
nodes.rationale: An auto-checker marking a wrong answer correct looks right on review and slips through, so auto-check is opted into.

nodes.label: Failed read distinct from empty result
nodes.rationale: The codebase had four user-visible incidents from confusing read failure with no data.

nodes.label: Enumeration partial credit
nodes.rationale: Order-independent; a repeated correct answer is credited once and extras never exceed the item points.

nodes.label: Score release gate
nodes.rationale: The student sees nothing until a teacher has reviewed and released the submission.

nodes.label: Answered worksheet question lock
nodes.rationale: Saving replaces items wholesale and worksheet_answers cascades on delete, so saving after anyone answered would destroy answers; the check sits in the hook so a second caller cannot reintroduce it.

nodes.label: Incremental answer saving
nodes.rationale: The hosting tier drops connections, and losing a half-finished worksheet is worse than an extra write per answer.

nodes.label: Paper scoring path
nodes.rationale: A file-only worksheet could otherwise never produce a score, leaving Worksheet Performance empty for classes working on paper.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER shared predicates
nodes.rationale: A policy sub-selecting its own table recurses, and one joining another RLS table silently narrows when that policy changes.

nodes.label: Worksheet Performance metric
nodes.rationale: Averages released submissions only, since an unreleased score is not the student's to see.

hyperedges.label: Student write restrictions on scoring fields
